tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs | 5+ yrs E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over five years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, microservices and REST/OCC APIs. Proven record designing PIM-ERP-MDM integrations, data pipelines and API migrations. Strong in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, agile delivery and techno-functional analysis, translating business needs into robust e-commerce platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: INTERIM Java/ Fluent Commerce Developer (gn)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by the opportunity to support your finance workstream with deep SAP Commerce expertise. Over the past five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have designed and delivered robust Hybris platforms, built extensive OCC REST APIs and led complex PIM-ERP-MDM integrations. My background aligns perfectly with the interim Java/Fluent Commerce role you seek.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, covering product catalog, pricing and order management for global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Java & Spring Development
bullets.text: Developed high-performance Java services using Spring and Spring Boot, exposing OCC REST APIs for headless commerce and third-party consumption.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) and migrated customer account APIs, ensuring seamless ERP and MDM integration.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: Delivered features in Scrum teams, executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, and supported production with Docker/Kubernetes-based cloud deployments.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to your finance-focused interim project because it combines cutting-edge e-commerce technology with complex data integration challenges. Your remote-first model and emphasis on rapid delivery match my experience driving SAP Commerce transformations for multinational enterprises. I am eager to apply my SAP Hybris, Java and integration expertise to help your team achieve seamless, scalable finance solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leverage 5+ years of SAP Commerce, Java and integration expertise to deliver high-impact interim solutions for your finance workstream, while thriving in a remote, agile environment.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) developer with 5+ years experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’d love to discuss how I can contribute to your interim Java/Fluent Commerce project. Let’s connect!
